title_en: Sony Confirms PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December 2026
summary_en: Sony has confirmed the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December, which will be available to download from Tuesday, December 1 to Monday January 4.
body_en:
Sony has confirmed the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December, which will be available to download from Tuesday, December 1 to Monday January 4.
In a PlayStation Blog post , Sony said Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, and Amnesia: The Bunker are December’s three titles. Will you be able to tear yourself away from GTA 6 to give either of these games a shot? Or perhaps you're after a palate cleanser after pumping 100 hours into Rockstar's epic?
It’s worth noting that PlayStation Plus members have until Monday, November 30 to add the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for November (Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered, Monster Train 2) to their library.
